name: biomedical_drug_protein_interaction_benchmarks
description: A suite of benchmarks evaluating models that predict interactions between small-molecule drugs and protein targets. It aggregates tasks for detecting or classifying drug–protein relationships from molecular data and/or biomedical text to support model comparison for drug-target interaction prediction. Benchmarks typically measure binary interaction prediction, ranking of candidate targets, and relation extraction performance.
evaluation_method: F1 (with AUC and accuracy commonly reported)
reputation: A niche, research-focused benchmark on Hugging Face used by groups working on biomedical relation extraction and drug–target prediction, with limited broad adoption.
